Name: Sweet Jabs
Components: V, S, M (A brand flavoured candy)
Description:
All the love in the world will only block up an artery. You point your finger to a creature within reach, a sickeningly pink glow shooting out for them. That creature must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffer 1d4 psychic damage and gain a +1 bonus to their attack and damage rolls, as an overwhelming satisfaction washes over them. On a success, nothing happens.

This damage and effect repeats at the start of the afflicted creature’s turns, up until they have gained a cumulative +3 bonus. If they have a +3 bonus from this effect, at the start of their next turn they instead suffer 6d12 psychic damage and become Paralyzed until the end of their next turn.
